svg.text: Plan for the 5 report pages, sketched before the Power BI build — Phase 4 blueprint

g.text: Fiscal Quarter Progress vs. Prior Quarter
Seasonality Heatmap — Month x Fiscal Year
Avg Monthly Net Payroll — before / during / after lockdown
Recovery Timeline — months to return to pre-COVID average
Monthly, manual — drop new PDF, hit Refresh
1 file unparseable; provisional figures revised later
KPI card (colored bar = accent, not meaning)
Waterfall: green = gain, red = drop vs. prior month
Heatmap: darker = higher value that month
Every page now carries 3 distinct visuals
plus its KPI row — a plan to build from, not a
screenshot of the finished report. Update this
file if the actual build ends up diverging.
